provenance.cardiac_output: 本项目心脏模型实算（四腔时变弹性腔 + Windkessel，60.5 s 静息窗）
provenance.sma_fraction: The splanchnic bed receives about 25 % of cardiac output at rest and the superior mesenteric artery about 10 %, roughly doubling to tripling after a meal (Barrett KE et al., Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology 26th ed., ch. 32; Doppler series give fasting SMA flow 0.3-0.6 L/min and postprandial 1.0-1.6 L/min) —— 教科书量级，非本项目实测
provenance.smv_share: 静脉回流取动脉流量的 92%（其余为淋巴回流与肠腔净吸收水分），教科书量级近似

published_reference_cm_s: superior mesenteric artery, time-averaged mean velocity by duplex Doppler (peak systolic is 100-200 cm/s fasting; the model computes a time-averaged value, so the mean range is the one that applies)
superior mesenteric vein, time-averaged mean velocity by duplex Doppler

mesenteric collecting lymphatics, 1-10 mm/s by intravital microscopy (Dixon JB et al., Microcirculation 2006, doi:10.1080/10739680600893909). That is a RAT mesentery measurement - no human intestinal-lymphatic velocity series exists - and is labelled as such wherever it is shown.

audit.audit_statement: v(s) = Q(s)/A(s) with Q and A both strictly positive, so no sample on any path can be negative; the audit counts the samples rather than asserting it

mass_balance_mL_min.residual_note: 动脉入 - 静脉出 - 淋巴出 = 肠腔净吸收水分，本模型按教科书量级取 8% 的静脉回流折减，不是实测闭合

audit.arcades_excluded: the arcade anastomoses carry no net flow at rest and are not part of any flow path
